description: This Kotlin source file defines the MainActivity for an Android TicTacToe app. It manages the game UI, user interactions, and game state rendering.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the TicTacToe game handling UI updates, user interactions, and game state management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, restores state if available, sets up UI components, and attaches event handlers.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current game state to the bundle for activity recreation.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates the UI to reflect the current game state, including cell contents, colors, and game over conditions.

methods.name: showResultSnackbar
methods.description: Displays a Snackbar with the game result and provides a reset action.
